## Contributors

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
import qrcode
from IPython.display import display


DIRECTORY = Path(
    "/Users/wattez/Documents/pro/cytopia-book/_sub/cytopia/about"
)


def extract_front_matter(path: Path):
    """Extrait le front matter YAML d'un fichier QMD."""

    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = content.splitlines()

    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != "---":
        return {}

    end = next(
        (
            i
            for i, line in enumerate(lines[1:], start=1)
            if line.strip() == "---"
        ),
        None,
    )

    if end is None:
        return {}

    yaml_content = "\n".join(lines[1:end])

    try:
        return yaml.safe_load(yaml_content) or {}
    except yaml.YAMLError as e:
        print(f"Erreur YAML dans {path}: {e}")
        return {}


def format_categories(categories):
    if not categories:
        return ""

    categories.sort()

    return " · ".join(cat.title() for cat in categories)


def format_links(links):
    if not links:
        return ""

    result = []

    for link in links:
        text = link.get("text").title()
        href = link.get("href")

        if text and href:
            result.append(f"[{text}]({href})")

    result.sort()

    return " · ".join(result)


def format_affiliation(affiliation):
    if not affiliation:
        return ""

    if isinstance(affiliation, list):
        return ", ".join(str(item) for item in affiliation)

    if isinstance(affiliation, dict):
        values = []

        if affiliation.get("institution"):
            values.append(affiliation["institution"])

        if affiliation.get("laboratory"):
            values.append(affiliation["laboratory"])

        if affiliation.get("country"):
            values.append(affiliation["country"])

        return ", ".join(values)

    return str(affiliation)


def format_author(author_slug, metadata):
    title = metadata.get("title", "Unknown author")
    bio = metadata.get("bio", "").strip()
    categories = format_categories(metadata.get("categories"))
    affiliation = format_affiliation(metadata.get("affiliation"))

    links = format_links(
        metadata.get("about", {}).get("links", [])
    )

    output = []

    output.append("")
    output.append(f"## {title} {{#sec-{author_slug}}}")
    output.append("")
    output.append(f"\\qrcode[height=2cm]{{https://www.cytopia.fr/about/{author_slug}}}")
    output.append("")

    if affiliation:
        output.append(f"`Affiliation:` {affiliation}")
        output.append("")

    if categories:
        output.append(f"`Contribution:` {categories}")
        output.append("")

    if bio:
        output.append("`Biography:`")
        output.append(bio)
        output.append("")

    if links:
        output.append(f"`Links:` {links}")
        output.append("")

    return "\n".join(output)


def scan_qmd_directory(directory):
    documents = []

    for path in directory.rglob("index.qmd"):
        metadata = extract_front_matter(path)

        if metadata and metadata.get("title") != "About":
            metadata['name'] = metadata['title'].split(' ')[-1]
            documents.append({
                "path": path.relative_to(directory),
                "metadata": metadata,
            })

    documents.sort(key=lambda x: x['metadata']['name'])

    return documents


def generate_markdown(documents):
    sections = []

    for document in documents:
        sections.append(
            format_author(document["path"].parent.name, document["metadata"])
        )

    return "\n\n".join(sections)

documents = scan_qmd_directory(DIRECTORY)

markdown = generate_markdown(documents)

print(markdown)
```
